newsitem.title: FRANCE: French 97 car sales seen falling 10 pct - minister.
newsitem.headline: French 97 car sales seen falling 10 pct - minister.

text.p: France's Industry Minister Franck Borotra said the country's 1997 car sales were likely to fall by 10 percent.
"For the car industry, we have started a year 1997 in which we will probably see a fall in sales of 10 percent in cars in our country," Borotra said during a parliamentary debate on Tuesday.

Borotra said that a notable exception to the fall was the success of the Renault Megane and he said the company's Douai plant needed to be "flexible" in order to accommodate the sudden surge in sales.
